subject.title: Model Setup 'Test & use' fails on configless gateways: prepared model runtime owner was not committed after replacement

question: Should the prepared-runtime lifecycle owner be repaired now for configless gateway Model Setup activation, with a regression test covering the first-run Control UI flow?
rationale: The report describes a P0 user-facing lockout and is protected by the `maintainer` label; a maintainer should confirm the intended ownership invariant before a targeted repair proceeds.

options.title: Sponsor a targeted lifecycle repair
options.body: Confirm the configless activation contract, add a focused regression test, and repair the owner commit/rebind path without adding a new model-setting surface.

options.title: Verify current main first
options.body: Reproduce the exact configless gateway flow on current main before changing the lifecycle boundary if a maintainer believes later work may already have resolved it.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a targeted lifecycle repair
recommendation.body: Confirm the configless activation contract, add a focused regression test, and repair the owner commit/rebind path without adding a new model-setting surface.
